candidate_title: Assisted Declarative Process Creation from Natural Language Descriptions

review_output.decision_rationale: The title/abstract explicitly describe using Natural Language Processing to support creating declarative process models from natural-language descriptions, including mapping text documents to process-model elements (e.g., DCR graphs and roles/activities/constraints). This matches the Stage 1 observable signal for NLP-driven process representation construction from natural language text.
